WELCOME.title: Welcome to Vendora
WELCOME.intro: Vendora turns B2B quotes into Shopify draft orders. Setup takes a few minutes. Here is what Vendora adds to your store:

ELIGIBILITY.title: Check your store
ELIGIBILITY.intro: Vendora needs these to create quotes for your B2B customers.

SETTINGS.title: Approval rules
SETTINGS.intro: Quotes within these rules are approved automatically when submitted. Anything above them waits for a manager. Quote numbers start at Q-1001 and quotes expire after 30 days; you can change this and more in Settings later.

TEAM.title: Your team
TEAM.intro: Staff appear in Vendora the first time they open the app. New staff start as sales reps; you change roles in Settings → Team.

CONNECTION.title: Test the connection
CONNECTION.intro: Vendora creates a test draft order for one of your companies, reads it back and deletes it. Nothing is sent to anyone.

SAMPLE.title: Create your first quote
SAMPLE.intro: You're ready. Pick a company location, add products and submit the quote. Nothing is sent to the buyer until you choose to send it.

welcome.draftOrders: A draft order in Shopify for every approved quote, kept in sync when the quote changes.
welcome.emails: Emails to your team and your buyers: approvals, quotes and reminders before a quote expires.
welcome.customerPage: A page in your buyers' customer accounts where they see, accept or decline their quotes.
